preconditions.description: The number of vertices n and edges m are within the specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n and a != b and 1 <= c <= 10000 for a, b, c in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct valid vertices with a positive flow volume.
The number of edges provided matches m.
The graph is connected and a valid solution is guaranteed to exist.

postconditions.expression: len(output_lines) == m and all(d in (0, 1) for d in output_lines)
postconditions.description: The output contains exactly m lines, each being 0 or 1.

postconditions.expression: all((d == 0 and (u, v) in directed_edges) or (d == 1 and (v, u) in directed_edges) for i, (u, v, c) in enumerate(edges) for d in [output_lines[i]])
postconditions.description: The output directions correctly map to the directed edges: 0 means u->v, 1 means v->u.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(c for u, v, c in edges if (u, v) in directed_edges) == sum(c for u, v, c in edges if (v, u) in directed_edges) for v in range(2, n))
postconditions.description: For every intermediate vertex v (1 < v < n), the sum of flow on incoming edges equals the sum of flow on outgoing edges.

postconditions.expression: all(u != 1 for u, v, c in edges if (u, v) in directed_edges)

postconditions.description: The resulting directed graph contains no cycles.
